scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test && node --test scripts/check-no-secrets.test.mjs scripts/check-readme-config.test.mjs scripts/deploy-config.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/setup-wizard.test.mjs scripts/agents-md.test.mjs && node scripts/check-no-secrets.mjs && vitest run

FEISHU_APP_ID.description: 飞书或 Lark 应用的 App ID，在开放平台「凭证与基础信息」页面。 Feishu or Lark App ID from the app's Credentials and Basic Info page.

FEISHU_APP_SECRET.description: 飞书或 Lark 应用的 App Secret，与 App ID 在同一凭证页面。 Feishu or Lark App Secret from the same Credentials page.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: 用 `openssl rand -hex 32` 生成的随机字符串，用来签名登录 cookie。 A random string from `openssl rand -hex 32`, used to sign the login cookie.

OWNER_OPEN_ID.description: 先填 pending。第一次登录会被拒绝，页面只显示你自己的 open_id；把那个值填到这里之后才能连接。 Start with pending. The first login is denied and the page shows only your open_id; paste that value here before anyone can connect.

FEISHU_REGION.description: feishu（飞书，默认）或 lark（Lark）。其他值会拒绝全部请求。 feishu (Feishu, the default) or lark (Lark). Any other value rejects every request.

PUBLIC_URL.description: 留空则使用本次请求自己的源。要固定自定义域名时再填写完整源，例如 https://connector.example。 Leave empty to use the request's own origin. Set a full origin only to pin a custom domain, for example https://connector.example.

ALLOWED_REDIRECT_URIS.description: 允许的 OAuth 回调地址，逗号分隔。默认包含 Claude 和 ChatGPT，其他客户端把回调追加在后面。 Comma-separated allowed OAuth redirect URIs. The default includes Claude and ChatGPT; append other clients.
